open_findings.observed: One or four users at baseline and all samples still pass for 600 mock seconds.
open_findings.required_correction: Enforce the declared five-user workload at baseline and throughout the measurement, including mid-window drops.
open_findings.title: Pilot accepts fewer than the required five users

open_findings.interpretation: Insufficient evidence of sustained activity, not proof of inactivity; long in-flight requests can also leave completion counters flat.
open_findings.observed: Five users, flat earlier completion counts, and a single final increment pass the entire 600-second mock window.
open_findings.required_correction: Define a conservative activity-evidence policy across the window. For flat intervals, add bounded metadata evidence of ongoing activity or withhold success as unproven; do not invent a response-throughput floor.
open_findings.title: A final request completion does not establish sustained activity across the load window

readiness_scope: A hosted pilot whose passing status certifies the requested workload; this is not a claim that diagnostic execution is operationally unsafe.
remaining_acceptance_evidence: Fresh hosted exact-28 healthy startup within 900 seconds
At least 600 seconds of verified five-user request activity with sustained health/forwarding
Exact nonempty service-edge precision at least 0.95 on the actual capture
Three qualifying cold starts bound to the final candidate
Applicable traced timings, original-specific replay and holdout evidence
